instructions: Read ANTIGRAVITY_BRIDGE.md from origin/agent-control before execution.
Fetch origin/modern-runtime and verify exact code.base_sha before starting.
Create a working branch antigravity/prima-20260921-004 from code.base_sha.
Implement a first-version radiologist evidence panel for positive PRIMA labels in the human-readable HTML report.
Do not describe thumbnails as proof, confirmation, true ROI, ground-truth localization, segmentation, or definitive lesion location.
Use wording such as ảnh gợi ý rà lại, lát cắt tiêu biểu, and hỗ trợ rà soát study.

Reuse the existing local CASE001 staged study and existing CASE001_predictions.json/runtime_metrics.json from prior tasks. Do not rerun full PRIMA inference unless technically necessary for local validation.

Add deterministic mapping from diagnosis groups to preferred MRI series keywords. At minimum: ischemic -> DWI/ADC/FLAIR; hemorrhagic -> SWI/T2*/GRE/FLAIR; tumor -> T1 post/T1+C/T1 CE/T2/FLAIR/DWI; structural/ventricular -> T2/FLAIR/T1; infectious/inflammatory -> DWI/FLAIR/T2/T1 post; trauma -> SWI/T2*/FLAIR/DWI.
Rank locally available series by preferred keyword matches. Series names may be used locally but must not be written to GitHub results if they could contain PHI.

Implement representative slice selection for chosen series without using patient-derived model localization. Prefer slices within the middle 60 percent of the volume, high non-background brain content, useful intensity variation, and spatially separated selections.
Generate 3 to 6 local thumbnail PNGs per relevant positive-label evidence panel when suitable series are available.
Store patient-derived thumbnails only under the local study output directory, for example output/CASE001/evidence/. They must remain git-ignored and must never be pushed to GitHub.
Extend CASE001_report.html so each positive label can show: diagnosis label, review-aid disclaimer, preferred/selected series, and thumbnail grid.
Default report must remain radiologist-first: no raw model code or margin in the main evidence section.
Keep raw CASE001_predictions.json unchanged.
Add synthetic/non-PHI regression tests for series ranking, representative slice selection, report evidence rendering, HTML escaping, and absence of patient-derived file uploads.
Run the relevant focused tests.
Re-render CASE001_report.html locally from the existing prediction JSON and local staged MRI data.
Verify locally that at least one suitable positive label has evidence thumbnails if suitable series exist.

Push only source code/tests to the working branch and push only non-PHI aggregate checks in the task result. Do not push thumbnails, DICOM, screenshots, patient report contents, prediction JSON, series names, or per-label logits.

acceptance: Working branch antigravity/prima-20260921-004 is created from the exact base SHA
Synthetic tests cover evidence-series ranking and representative-slice selection
Human-readable HTML can render an evidence panel under positive PRIMA labels
Evidence panel explicitly states thumbnails are review aids and not proof/localization ground truth
CASE001 report is re-rendered locally without rerunning full inference unless necessary
At least one positive label receives local evidence thumbnails when suitable series exist
No DICOM, patient-derived thumbnail, screenshot, report content, series name, patient identifier, source path, or per-label patient logits are pushed to GitHub
A terminal non-PHI result is pushed to .antigravity/results/PRIMA-20260921-004.json
